case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

sup:70510.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
sup:70510.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

message.subject: Motor IE3 7.5 kW - your letter of 14 September
message.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

thank you for your letter of 14 September. We understand the copper pressure and want a price that is sustainable for you - and one we can plan with: a fixed price for 2027.

Our volume forecast for part:350011 changed by +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

We can offer: A) EUR 367.00 per unit, 90 days, fixed price; B) EUR 365.50 per unit, 60 days, fixed price.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
response.subject: Re: Motor IE3 7.5 kW - your letter of 14 September
response.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge the positive adjustment in your volume forecast and have factored this into our calculation. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €371.07 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. As an alternative at our standard terms, we therefore propose a revised price of EUR 369.02 per unit, maintaining the 30-day payment term to offer you the most competitive rate. Specifically, this alternative entails a price of €369.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

message.subject: Re: Motor IE3 7.5 kW
message.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

thank you. If the fixed price is difficult, we can accept your copper clause: EUR 361.50 per unit, 90 days, CU-NOTATION clause (20% share, 5% deadband).

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
response.subject: Re: Motor IE3 7.5 kW
response.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We appreciate your flexibility in proposing the CU-NOTATION clause to manage material risks. 

We can accept your terms and await your order. We are pleased to accept your offer of EUR 361.50 per unit with 90 days payment terms and the specified copper clause. This agreement provides a sustainable basis for our continued partnership and ensures planning security for both sides. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Our Angebot is valid for 30 days. To state our own terms, our offer is a price of €361.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Legal Department: We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION, CU-NOTATION, CU-NOTATION.
